description: OpenTelemetry Spring Boot Autoconfigure wires OpenTelemetry instrumentation into Spring Boot applications automatically, using Spring's dependency injection, bean post-processing, and AOP mechanisms to configure tracing and metrics for components such as spring-web, spring-webmvc, spring-webflux, Kafka, MongoDB, R2DBC, JDBC, and logging appenders. It underlies the opentelemetry-spring-boot-starter artifact, letting developers add distributed tracing to Spring applications with minimal manual setup.
